user.title: Select an Arriva line
user.description: Select a line from the timetable. Optionally type a line number or town to filter the list. Next, choose destination and stop.

stop.title: Select a stop
stop.description: Select the stop you want to follow in this direction.

devices.title: Live Activity and colours
devices.description: Optionally select multiple iPhones. The integration starts immediately. Use its switch or your own automation to turn it off.

data_description.delay_color: More than 60 seconds late. Red by default. Clear the field or choose Default to reset.
data_description.early_color: Green from 30 seconds early (−30 sec or earlier). Scheduled waiting does not count as early departure.
data_description.on_time_color: White by default, from −29 through +60 seconds. Waiting and unavailable information are gray; a cancelled bus is red.

abort.already_configured: This line, destination and stop are already configured.

error.invalid_selection: Choose an option from the list.
error.invalid_iphone: Select an Apple iPhone connected through the Home Assistant Companion app.
error.catalog_unavailable: No valid line catalogue available. Retry or install the latest integration version.

init.title: Live Activity and colours
init.description: Control the integration with its switch or your own automation. Select one or more iPhones for Live Activity.

data_description.mobile_device: Optionally select one or more iPhones that should show the current journey on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island.
data_description.delay_color: More than 60 seconds late. Red by default. Clear the field or choose Default to reset.
data_description.early_color: Green from 30 seconds early (−30 sec or earlier). Scheduled waiting does not count as early departure.
data_description.on_time_color: White by default, from −29 through +60 seconds. Waiting and unavailable information are gray; a cancelled bus is red.

error.invalid_iphone: Select an Apple iPhone connected through the Home Assistant Companion app.
error.device_clear_failed: Could not end the activity on a removed device. Check connectivity and retry.
